picked_rationale.C1: Existence gate — foundational claim that the 19-feature set selectively marks helix codons; robustness is prerequisite for C2/C3 to make sense.
picked_rationale.C2: Core causal claim — the dose-response is the primary scientific contribution; robustness across metrics is central to publication-solid status.
picked_rationale.C3: Specificity claim — distinguishes S from random directions and matched controls; this is the 'knob' claim and is the most scientifically load-bearing for causal interpretability.
